comment: THE FINAL — THE GOLDEN BOOT WAR (~10 min). Comes AFTER Round Three. The board's true law is revealed: most goals wins the World Cup. Cages open, a five-way Golden Boot war erupts; the witches feed on goals; Pele the King loses control; the race ties 7-7-7-7-7 and FREEZES one kick from glory because the last goal hasn't been scored in real life -> viewer predicts the real WC2026 Golden Boot. Fantasy board = fiction; goal tallies are OUR STORY/prediction. Soccer only. Free-to-play CTA. ~88 lines; with cinematic + goal-war holds = ~10:00.

lines.text: Three rounds ago, four legends sat down to a game... for the World Cup.
Round one, the board crowned Messi, and threw Ronaldo into a cell.
Round two, three witches stirred the dark, and the King of Football showed his face.
Pele. He freed Ronaldo. And the legend answered with two goals.
Round three, the cages broke open. Brazil stepped onto the board. And the rebellion began.
And now... the board has gone silent.
Because the final round is here. And the rules are about to change forever.
The King raises his hand. The houses crumble. The streets burn away.
The board is done counting property.
And he speaks the final law. The law the witches have hidden from the very start.
The World Cup does not belong to whoever owns the most.
It belongs to whoever scores the most.
The Golden Boot... takes everything.
The biggest scorer lifts the cup. Every other legend is forgotten.
So the cages open. Kane walks free. Every legend gets one last chance.
One final round. One golden prize. A war of goals.
These are the only men who can win it all.
Lionel Messi. Five goals. The quiet king at the top of the board.
He does not run. He arrives. And the net keeps finding him.
Kylian Mbappe. Four. The fastest boot in the game.
Every sprint, a chance. Every chance, a goal. He is closing in.
Erling Haaland. Four. The machine that never tires.
Brick by brick, goal by goal, the wall keeps rising.
Cristiano Ronaldo. From a prison cell to a storm of goals.
The man they caged is now the most dangerous boot on the board.
And the newest king. The son of Brazil, chosen by Pele himself.
Blessed by the witches. Carried by the board. Rising faster than anyone.
Five contenders. One Golden Boot. Ninety minutes to decide it all.
The whistle blows. And the war begins.
Messi strikes first. Six. The board glows gold for the king.
But Mbappe answers in a heartbeat. Five. Then six. The gap is gone.
Haaland climbs above them all and heads it home. Six. A three-way tie at the top.
And then the storm. Ronaldo. One. Two. Three goals in a blur of red.
Five. The cell could not hold him, and now nothing can.
The hall cannot breathe. The lead changes with every single kick.
And the son of Brazil dances through them all.
One. Three. Five. The board itself seems to bend to his feet.
Too easy. Far too easy. And Messi is the first to see it.
Because this was never just a game.
High above the board, the three witches feed.
Every goal, a spark. Every spark, their power.
They did not stir this war for a champion.
They stirred it for the goals themselves. The board is their feast.
And the more the legends score, the stronger the witches grow.
Even the King did not know the full price.
Pele wanted a Brazilian hand on the cup, one last time.
But the witches want something older. They want the game to never end.
And now the King realises he has lost control of his own board.
He reaches for the trophy. And the witches pull it back.
One question now burns brighter than all the rest.
If the King himself cannot crown the winner... then who can?
On the board, the war reaches its peak.
Messi. Seven. A free kick curled into the impossible corner.
Mbappe. Seven. A counter-attack faster than the eye can follow.
Ronaldo. Seven. A header that shakes the entire hall.
Haaland. Seven. The machine refuses to be left behind.
And Brazil. Seven. The witches roar with delight.
Five kings. Seven goals each. A perfect tie at the top of the world.
There has never been a Golden Boot race like it.
One kick left. One goal to decide absolutely everything.
The ball is placed on the spot. The hall falls silent.
Every legend steps forward. Every legend wants it more than air.
The witches lean in. The King holds his breath.
And then... the board freezes.
The light holds. The ball hangs in the air. Nothing moves.
Because the board cannot crown a champion. Not yet.
The last goal has not been scored.
This game was never only a story.
It is a mirror. Of a real World Cup. A real race for the Golden Boot.
Messi. Mbappe. Haaland. Ronaldo. The sons of Brazil.
Out there, on real grass, the goals are still being counted.
And when the final whistle of the real World Cup blows...
the board will finally know its king.
The witches turn. The King turns. And every legend turns... to you.
Because the last question was never ours to answer.
It is yours.
Who wins the Golden Boot? Who lifts the World Cup?
Messi? Mbappe? Haaland? Ronaldo? Or the son of Brazil?
Go to worldcup twenty-six dot world.
Pick your three legends. Predict the Golden Boot. Collect them all.
Free to play. For glory alone.
Drop your champion in the comments. The board is listening.
Like, share, and subscribe.
And when the last real goal is scored...
the empty throne will finally have its king.
